title: UniRec: Bridging the Expressive Gap between Generative and Discriminative Recommendation via Chain-of-Attribute
abstract: arXiv:2604.12234v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative Recommendation (GR) reframes retrieval and ranking as autoregressive decoding over Semantic IDs (SIDs), unifying the multi-stage pipeline into a single model. Yet a fundamental expressive gap persists: discriminative models score items with direct feature access enabling explicit user-item crossing, whereas GR decodes over compact SID tokens without item-side signal. We formalize this via Bayes' theorem: ranking by p(y|f,u) is equivalent to ranking by p(f|y,u), which factorizes autoregressively over item features, showing that a generative model with full feature access matches its discriminative counterpart, with any practical gap stemming solely from incomplete feature coverage. translated_title: UniRec：通过属性链弥合生成式与判别式推荐之间的表达能力鸿沟
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐（GR）将检索和排序重新框定为对语义标识符（SIDs）的自回归解码，将多阶段流程统一到单一模型中。然而，一个根本性的表达能力鸿沟依然存在：判别式模型通过直接访问特征对物品打分，从而实现显式的用户-物品交叉，而生成式推荐则在不具备物品侧信号的紧凑SID词元上进行解码。我们通过贝叶斯定理对这一差距进行了形式化：按 p(y|f,u) 排序等价于按 p(f|y,u) 排序，后者可在物品特征上进行自回归分解，这表明具有完整特征访问能力的生成式模型可与其判别式对应模型相媲美，任何实际差距都仅源于特征覆盖的不完整。我们提出了UniRec，其核心机制为属性链。CoA在解码SID之前，为每个SID序列前置结构化的属性词元：类目、卖家、品牌，从而恢复了判别式模型所具备的物品侧特征交叉能力。
tldr: 提出UniRec框架，通过贝叶斯定理证明生成式与判别式推荐在特征完整时可相互等价，并以属性链机制在SID解码前引入类目、卖家、品牌等结构化属性词元，恢复了物品侧特征交叉能力，从而弥合两类推荐范式的表达能力鸿沟。
en_tdlr: UniRec theoretically proves the equivalence of generative and discriminative recommendation via Bayes' theorem and introduces Chain-of-Attribute (CoA), which prepends structured attribute tokens (category, seller, brand) to SID sequences to recover item-side feature crossing, bridging the expressive gap between the two paradigms.
